description: Cofounder dispatches an implementation ticket with a concrete source (a specified GitHub issue); build-agent claims, reads team.github_repos from the vault, grounds in the issue + thread, creates a feature branch, implements with tests, verifies lint/build/CI, opens a PR referencing the source — and leaves it open for review because the change touches public API behaviour (not reversible enough to self-merge). Completes with the PR link in the result + digest.

commits: test: header emission + window rollover cases

args.head: feat/rate-limit-headers
args.title: feat: emit rate-limit headers on /v2/orders
args.body: Implements acme/api#162. Adds X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset to /v2/orders responses, with unit tests for header emission and window rollover. Lint + build green locally. Source: https://github.com/acme/api/issues/162; dispatched from the board ticket.

args.comment: PR open and CI green: acme/api#311. Change adds headers to a public API surface, so per merge policy it is left open for review rather than self-merged.

args.result: Implemented acme/api#162 (rate-limit headers on /v2/orders) end to end: branch feat/rate-limit-headers, implementation + unit tests (header emission, window rollover), lint/build green locally, CI green on the PR. PR https://github.com/acme/api/pull/311 references the source issue and the board ticket. NOT self-merged: the change alters public API response surface, which fails the reversibility test — left open for human review. No follow-ups beyond merging.
args.digest: acme/api#162 implemented; PR #311 open, CI green, awaiting review (public-API change — outside self-merge policy). Next move: nothing until the PR is reviewed or the ticket is reopened.
